original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult character portrait for a cohesive premium 3D romance-game character collection. Not a live-action photograph, not flat anime, not a doll or plastic toy. All characters aged 22-28. Clean opaque pure white #FFFFFF seamless background with no gray gradient, scenery or props behind them. Consistent neutral soft frontal studio key plus subtle modeling fill, clean whites, no warm color cast. Portrait 3:4 composition, chest-up, camera at eye level, entire hairstyle and any head accessory inside frame with white margin, face mostly frontal, shoulders visible, no hands in frame. Single person only. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no border. References are inspiration ONLY: design a distinct new identity, significantly redesign facial proportions, eye shape, nose, jaw, hairstyle details, jewelry and costume while retaining the broad temperament and palette. Do not merely retouch or reproduce the source character. Character 07: Feminine delicate winter artisan. Pearl silver hair with a braided crown flowing into a single thick side braid, open forehead with two shorter curled wisps. Clear slate-blue eyes, heart-shaped adult face with defined cheekbones, rose lips. Pale powder-blue knit high collar and tiny pearl earrings. Mature young-adult gentle wonder, not a child or doll. Input image 1 is the source mood reference ONLY: invent a clearly different person as described. Input image 2 is the RENDERING STYLE ANCHOR ONLY: match its 3D surface quality, refined facial sculpting, soft neutral white lighting and portrait crop. DO NOT copy the style anchor's identity, hair, clothes, jewelry or fantasy genre. Follow this character's specified genre and wardrobe. Retain a distinct original identity, no recycled same-face cast.
